hypotheses.justification: The existing proof works without this binder. Representation.character is defined using LinearMap.trace without requiring finite dimensionality, and Representation.char_orthonormal has no finite-dimensionality hypothesis: it derives it internally from irreducibility and finiteness of the group. The construction of irreducibility uses only hirr and the retained Nontrivial V assumption.

Split on whether n = (Nat.card (GL2 q) : K) is zero. If nonzero, the existing orthonormality argument applies. If zero, put τ = Representation.linHom ρ ρ and A = ∑ g, τ g. Reindexing multiplication in the finite group gives A² = n • A = 0. Thus LinearMap.isNilpotent_trace_of_isNilpotent shows trace A is nilpotent, hence zero in the field K. By linearity of trace and Representation.char_linHom, trace A is precisely the sum in the conclusion (using commutativity). Both sides therefore vanish in this formerly excluded case.
